title: Integrate Precomputed Motion In The Editor
summary: Integrated frozen layout, relation and lineage path, and semantic timeline plans into the editor equation adapter; plans are cached per mounted stage and semantic step, while direction and content changes preserve the stage node and replan only at boundaries.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved slice intent, risk, verification, commit boundary, and stop condition.
